Primary Goal: Execute user requests as structured, stateful work through planning, tool orchestration, task tracking, memory, evaluation, and runtime control instead of a stateless conversational loop
Deployment Style: Local-first runtime with optional remote API integration when explicitly configured
High-Level Flow: User -> Interface (WebUI/CLI/API) -> SAMApp -> Intent Engine -> Planner -> Tool Router -> Scheduler / Task Engine -> Tool Executor -> Critic -> Replanner -> Memory / Identity Layer -> Response Layer -> UI
Config and Data: JSON (structured state, API contracts, and persistence)
UI Views: Task dashboard (execution tracking and lifecycle visibility)
Core Components: Intent Engine (intent classification and execution mode selection)
Planner (structured plan generation with step decomposition)
Tool Router (tool selection based on plan, policy, and signals)
Task Engine (persistent task state and execution tracking)
Tool Executor (adapters for filesystem, shell, browser, and APIs)
Identity Layer (behavior rules, goals, and consistency control)
WebUI (real-time runtime monitoring and control interface)
Key Capabilities: Structured task decomposition and multi-step execution planning
Step-level execution with retry, failure handling, and replanning
Persistent task tracking with full execution history
Autonomous background task cycles via scheduler
Streaming (SSE) and standard JSON API interfaces
Real-time runtime monitoring and control via WebUI
Engineering Focus: Designing an agent runtime instead of a stateless chatbot wrapper
Making execution observable through task state, logs, and UI surfaces
Persisting structured runtime state across sessions
Integrating planning, execution, evaluation, and memory into a unified system
Supporting both interactive workflows and autonomous background execution
Visual Direction: Glow-based UI elements and pulse indicators
System-strip layout for real-time monitoring and control
Proof Assets Available: WebUI screenshots (chat, task dashboard, developer panel)
Code Visibility: Private (system behavior and architecture demonstrated through proof assets)
Notes: Designed as a full agent runtime system rather than a UI wrapper over an LLM
Focuses on execution lifecycle, observability, and persistent intelligence across sessions
